1.answer: A double is a whole number times a power of two, so it can only be a fraction whose denominator is a power of two. 1/10 has a factor 5 in its denominator, and no power of two is divisible by 5. So in binary, 1/10 repeats forever and has to be cut off and rounded.
1.quote: The denominator of 1/10 has a factor 5. No power of two is divisible by 5, so 1/10 never ends in binary:
